messages:
alex_lead: kicking off thread — customer GreenCorp wants a 2-week POC for semantic search + chat with SSO and data residency. ask: can we scope?

maria_se: noted. what's their expected QPS and dataset size?

alex_lead: ~200k docs, peak 10 qps, latency SLO 300ms, budget concerns.

ben_solutions: 200k docs fine but need embeddings & chunking. propose Redwood Dedicated trial for predictable perf.

sam_security: they asked for SOC2 + IP allowlist and KMS. we can do KMS and IP allowlist in Dedicated; SOC2 attestation available. need sec questionnaire answers by EOW.

alex_lead: can we get a rough cost estimate for Dedicated for 2 weeks (burst) vs hosted? customer budget ~ $10k.

ben_solutions: quick calc: hosted ~ $6k for that workload; Dedicated reserve, min month -> ~$18k. I'll put numbers in a doc.

maria_se: success criteria we agreed on: recall@10 > 0.75 on their eval set, end-to-end median latency < 350ms, and ingest of 200k docs in < 24h.

alex_lead: dev/ops ask: dataset contains PII. need private deployment or hosted with data retention policy?

sam_security: hosted retains logs; can set retention to 30 days and disable product analytics. But for regulated PII, recommend Dedicated or Private.

alex_lead: customer pushing to shorten POC to 1 week. that affects ingest and eval. can we compress?

maria_se: we can do incremental ingest + online evals to get early signal in 3 days, but final ingest+full eval needs 7-10 days. tradeoff noted.

ben_solutions: also fallback model plan: start with quantized llama-13b for cost, fallback to 70b for quality if needed. document toggle in runbook.

alex_lead: blockers: their SSO team requires SAML with specific attributes. any constraints?

sam_security: SAML supported in Dedicated; for hosted we have SSO via SAML where customer provides IdP metadata — ok. confirm attribute mapping.

devops_bot: deployment-note: created poc-ticket #POC-412 and assigned to @ben_solutions.

maria_se: action items: ben to send rough cost delta, sam to start sec questionnaire, alex to confirm timeline with customer.

alex_lead: thanks! will update after sync with customer tomorrow. :thumbsup:
